description: Hosting the Water Safety Conference and Exhibition 2026 of the International Water Conference
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-01-12 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The National Water Supply and Drainage Board has agreed to host the Water Safety Conference and Exhibition 2026 of the International Water Conference in Sri Lanka to coincide with the Annual Symposium under the theme of 'Water and Sustainable Development' of the National Water Supply and Drainage Board. The said conference and the exhibition will be attended by the leading global experts from academia, industry, government regulatory bodies and international organizations involved in the water sector. This will provide an opportunity to foster dialogue and collaboration among stakeholders committed to providing safe and sustainable drinking water, thereby promoting a meaningful international partnership. Accordingly, the Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Minister of Housing, Construction and Water Supply to host the Water Safety Conference and Exhibition 2026 of the International Water Conference at the Centre of Excellence for Water and Sanitation of the National Water Supply and Drainage Board in Ratmalana from 23rd to 25th March 2026, coinciding with World Water Day.
